components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; Console Violet fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: hsl(258 45% 65%); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(258 45% 60%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(258 45% 55%); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid hsl(258 20% 90%); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(258 55% 75%); color: hsl(258 45% 15%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default text field with focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid hsl(258 20% 90%); background: #fff; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: hsl(240 10% 3.9%); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(258 10% 45%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px hsl(258 45% 55%); }

components.name: Console Rail Nav Item
components.description: Navigation link in the permanently dark Console Rail; active state uses Console Violet.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); } .ds-rail-item-active { background: hsl(258 45% 65%); color: #fff; }

narrative.overview: This is a serious, dark-railed control console for running one business's warehouse, sales, purchasing, and accounting operations. It is restrained and professional by design: the UI is built almost entirely in neutral white/gray surfaces with one deliberate brand signal — Console Violet — that marks primary actions, active navigation, and focus states, derived from the company logo. The system does not perform brand expression for its own sake; density, scanability, and permission-gated clarity outrank decoration throughout, in line with the product's Operate-mode mandate across inventory, sales, purchasing, accounting, manufacturing, and POS workflows. The one standing exception to the system's flatness is the Console Rail: a permanently dark, fixed navigation sidebar (#240032) that frames every authenticated screen regardless of the app's own light/dark theme. It is the system's one piece of atmosphere — white-on-dark overlays, a glowing gradient tile around the logo — while the content canvas beside it stays light, dense, and businesslike.
keyCharacteristics: One brand accent (Console Violet) used sparingly against neutral surfaces.
A permanently dark navigation rail independent of the app's light/dark theme.
Flat-by-default surfaces; shadows are minimal, not a layered elevation system.
Status is communicated as colored text, not badges (badges are reserved for counts/tags).
Soft-square 8px radius as the default geometry, with one larger signature radius on the rail's logo tile.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Console Violet is reserved for primary actions, active/selected states, and focus rings. It does not spread across general UI chrome — most of the interface stays neutral so dense operational data stays legible.

rules.name: The Rail Stays Dark Rule
rules.body: The Console Rail is a fixed structural element, not a themed surface. It never switches to a light background, regardless of the signed-in user's light/dark preference for the rest of the app.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface in the system. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a second font family.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows are a light touch (shadow-sm) on cards and popovers, never a layered system. The one deliberate exception is the Console Rail's logo tile.

dos: Do reserve Console Violet for primary actions, active nav state, and focus rings (The One Accent Rule).
Do keep the Console Rail permanently dark (#240032) regardless of the app's light/dark theme (The Rail Stays Dark Rule).
Do render status/workflow values as colored text from the fixed tone set, not as badges.
Do use the 8px base radius for all standard controls; reserve the 16px signature radius for the rail's logo tile only.
Do keep shadows light (shadow-sm) and flat-by-default; let background-color layering do most of the depth work.
donts: Don't let Console Violet spread across general chrome, backgrounds, or large fills outside primary actions and active/focus states.
Don't theme the Console Rail to follow light/dark mode; it is a fixed structural element.
Don't introduce a second typeface; Inter carries the full hierarchy via size and weight.
Don't use badges for workflow/status values; badges are for counts, categories, or tags only.
Don't introduce a new shadow/elevation scale; the system is flat except for the rail's one signature glow.
